newsitem.title: UK: Oseberg to load equiv 46 standard cargoes in March.
newsitem.headline: Oseberg to load equiv 46 standard cargoes in March.

text.p: Norway's Oseberg crude system is due to load the equivalent of 46 standard cargoes of 500,000 barrels each in March, traders said.
They said the programme consisted of 27 cargoes of 600,000 barrels, six cargoes of 500,000 barrels, two cargoes of one million barrels and one of 1.8 million barrels, totalling 36 actual loadings.
The Oseberg system was scheduled to load the equivalent of 38.8 standard 500,000-barrel cargoes in February.
